mapper.sql:
SELECT 'PI' recordType,p.id,p.id piId,p.pi_no referenceNo,p.customer_id customerId,p.customer_name customerName,p.status, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') createdAt,DATE_FORMAT(p.updated_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') updatedAt,NULL expiresAt,p.currency_code currencyCode,p.total_amount totalAmount, COALESCE(pay.amount,0) paidAmount, COALESCE(q.orderedQty,items.quantity,0) orderedQty,COALESCE(q.shippedQty,0) shippedQty, COALESCE(q.remainingQty,items.quantity,0) remainingQty, p.revision,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.document_snapshot,'$.businessOwner')) businessOwner FROM bike_pi p JOIN bike_pi_series series ON series.id=p.series_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT pi_id,SUM(ordered_qty) quantity FROM bike_pi_item GROUP BY pi_id) items ON items.pi_id=p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT original.series_id,SUM(payment.amount) amount FROM bike_pi_payment payment JOIN bike_pi original ON original.id=payment.pi_id WHERE payment.status='CONFIRMED' GROUP BY original.series_id) pay ON pay.series_id=p.series_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link.series_id, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('CANCELLED','CLOSED') THEN i.shipped_qty ELSE i.ordered_qty END) orderedQty, SUM(i.shipped_qty) shippedQty, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('CANCELLED','CLOSED') THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(i.ordered_qty-i.shipped_qty,0) END) remainingQty FROM bike_pi_order_link link JOIN bike_sales_order o ON o.id=link.order_id JOIN bike_sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.id GROUP BY link.series_id) q ON q.series_id=p.series_id WHERE
p.status='DRAFT' p.id=series.current_pi_id AND p.status IN ('CONFIRMED','RELEASED')

choose.when: SELECT 'LOCK' recordType,l.id,NULL piId,l.lock_no referenceNo,l.customer_id customerId,c.customer_name customerName,l.status, DATE_FORMAT(l.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') createdAt,DATE_FORMAT(l.updated_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') updatedAt,DATE_FORMAT(l.expire_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') expiresAt,NULL currencyCode,NULL totalAmount,NULL paidAmount, l.lock_qty orderedQty,0 shippedQty,l.lock_qty-l.released_qty-l.converted_qty remainingQty,NULL revision,NULL businessOwner FROM bike_inventory_lock l LEFT JOIN bike_customer c ON c.id=l.customer_id WHERE l.status IN ('LOCKED','PARTIAL_CONVERTED') AND l.expire_time>NOW(3) AND l.expire_time<=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND l.lock_qty>l.released_qty+l.converted_qty

UNION ALL SELECT 'ORDER',o.id,NULL,o.order_no,o.customer_id,c.customer_name,o.status,DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),DATE_FORMAT(o.updated_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL, SUM(i.ordered_qty),SUM(i.shipped_qty),SUM(GREATEST(i.ordered_qty-i.shipped_qty,0)),NULL,NULL FROM bike_sales_order o JOIN bike_customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN bike_sales_order_item i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING','CONFIRMED','PARTIAL_SHIPPED')
AND 1=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi_order_link link WHERE link.order_id=o.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_pi p WHERE p.source_order_id=o.id) GROUP BY o.id,c.customer_name
